November 13th, 196) 
For Your Information 


TOWN OF PINCOURT YOUTH CENTRE 


We wish to draw your attention to what we believe 
is a most interesting community project. 

In consultation with citizens of the Town of Pincourt 
on Ile Perrot and the Town Council, the Lakeshore Y.M.C.A. has been 
invited to assist in the development of a teen centre within the town. 

The Town Council has made a house available to the 
teenagers at no cost and local citizens are contributing furniture and 
other items to the group in order to make the house operational. Over 
100 young people are now involved. All necessary renovations and 
improvements to the building are being done by the young people them- 
selves. 

If you are interested in developing a news feature 
story around this interesting example of a community rallying its many 


segments to meet a particular need, please contact Mr Terry Forth, 


Lakeshore Y.M.C.A., Telephone 695 - 9561. 


From: 
Harry E. Thomas, 
Public Relations Secretary.
